It Works With The Breather (Pcv) & Egr System 🔄 To Manage Blow-By Gases. When The Egr Or Pcv  Is Clogged, Oil Mist From The Crankcase Can Skip The Oil Separator And Get Pulled Straight Into The Combustion Chamber — That’S What Causes The White Smoke 🌫️. Once The Egr Is Cleaned Or Replaced, The Flow Returns To Normal And Smoke Disappears. In Some Engines A Pcv - Filter Will Also Be Integrated With The Pcv Valve, Like Chevy, Gmc Etc.. No Need For Engine Overhaul Or Blaming Piston Rings In This Case!

How It Works:

Egr (Exhaust Gas Recirculation) 🌫️  
Recirculates A Portion Of Exhaust Gas Into The Intake To Reduce Nox Emissions And Combustion Temperature.

Egr Valve 🔁  
Controls The Flow Of Exhaust Gas. If Stuck/Clogged, It Can Cause Power Loss, Rough Idle, Or Smoke.

Pcv (Positive Crankcase Ventilation) 🔄  
Vents Blow-By Gas From Crankcase Back To Intake. Keeps Internal Pressure In Check And Reduces Oil Leaks.

Together, They Reduce Emissions, Keep The Engine Clean, And Improve Performance 🚗💨.

When the EGR or PCV  is clogged, oil mist from the crankcase can skip the oil separator and get pulled straight into the combustion chamber — that’s what causes the white smoke 🌫️. Once the EGR is cleaned or replaced, the flow returns to normal and smoke disappears. In some engines a PCV - filter will also be integrated with the pcv valve, like Chevy, GMC etc.. No need for engine overhaul or blaming piston rings in this case!

How it works:

EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation) 🌫️  
Recirculates a portion of exhaust gas into the intake to reduce NOx emissions and combustion temperature.

EGR Valve 🔁  
Controls the flow of exhaust gas. If stuck/clogged, it can cause power loss, rough idle, or smoke.

PCV (Positive Crankcase Ventilation) 🔄  
Vents blow-by gas from crankcase back to intake. Keeps internal pressure in check and reduces oil leaks.

Together, they reduce emissions, keep the engine clean, and improve performance 🚗💨.

🔵💨Blue smoke: oil burning

⚫💨Black smoke : excess fuel burning 

⚪💨White smoke : coolant /water entered combustion Chamber [white smoke in the morning for few mins is common and natural].
